description: This PHP file defines a class 'PipelineBySalesStageDashlet' which extends 'DashletGenericChart'. It represents a dashlet component for displaying a pipeline report by sales stages in a CRM system. The file includes methods for initializing the dashlet, generating chart data, constructing database queries, and rendering an interactive chart with JavaScript. It specifically works within the SuiteCRM platform, utilizing its conventions and libraries, and is designed for use as a dashboard widget to visualize opportunities segmented by sales stages.

classes.name: PipelineBySalesStageDashlet
classes.description: A CRM dashlet class that visualizes opportunity pipeline data grouped by sales stages, providing interactive chart rendering and configuration options within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with default start and end dates, and sets the title if not provided.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Generates options for the dashlet configuration UI, particularly selecting sales stages to include in the chart.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the chart with data fetched via a constructed SQL query, outputting HTML and JavaScript for an interactive chart visualization.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Executes a SQL query to retrieve opportunity counts and totals grouped by sales stage, respecting the selected sales stages.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to fetch opportunity data within the specified date range and for selected sales stages.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into a structured format suitable for chart rendering, including labels and total calculations.

methods.name: resizeLabel
methods.description: Truncates labels exceeding a certain length, appending an ellipsis for better display on the chart.
